parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence and no universal visitor-facing exposure (no facility, custody or border rule documented) is a genuine positive. But the dossier documents a real police lever: officers invoke the ambiguous Article 331 to extract bribes from men perceived as gay — a practice that reaches visibly gender-nonconforming visitors — recurring in 2022 and 2023, with reports rare though investigated. Social hostility is documented at scale (73% capital survey, 2021-23), and LGBTQ+ violence by state and private actors is recorded, qualitative and without denominators; enforcement punishes reported violence, so rule of law partly works. The visitor has no anti-discrimination, hate-crime or gender-recognition route, leaving thin recourse. Resident gaps (no LGR, no equality statute) count only lightly. Net: state-tolerated extortion plus hostility without strong remedy — elevated risk.
